format: SPARQL CSV results, one file per country, label language, and birth year; a year that reaches the 5000-row limit is replaced by one file per month
sha256_rule: over the cached files concatenated in sorted file-name order

filters.rules: native name (P1559) used when in the label language's script; names NFC with whitespace collapsed; dropped: parentheses, commas, slashes, or ASCII digits; over 60 bytes; dominant script not the language's; fewer than two alphabetic tokens in Latin or Georgian; duplicates by (country, lowercase name)

split_rule: fnv1a64(0, lowercase normalized name) % 100: 0-89 train, 90-94 valid, 95-99 test; names are NFC with whitespace runs collapsed to one space
